note: Each story was reported on 19 November 2026. Key facts are backed by at least two trusted sources listed per story. Disputed or single-actor claims are worded with attribution in the headline/summary.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first trilateral in Shenzhen
stories.summary: 90-minute APEC-side meeting ends with a joint peace declaration on UN and ICC reform and nuclear counter-proliferation; no Ukraine settlement announced.

stories.headline: World Court: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
stories.summary: ICJ rules 9-6 that Myanmar bears state responsibility for genocide in northern Rakhine, ordering restitution measures and investigations.

stories.headline: Crimean Bridge hit for third time this week
stories.summary: Russia says Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge again; rail traffic was suspended and damage assessed. Kyiv calls the operation unprecedented.

stories.headline: Israeli tanks push into central Gaza
stories.summary: IDF launches a rare operation east of Nuseirat after evacuation orders, saying it targeted a tunnel; residents report artillery fire and flight.

stories.headline: Missile damages PIF Tower in Riyadh
sources: New York Times via Just Security
stories.summary: A strike on 19 Nov damaged Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund tower; three sources familiar say it was a Houthi missile. Houthis did not immediately claim it.

stories.headline: COP31 draft drops all fossil-fuel language
stories.summary: Antalya draft cut from 144 to 80 paragraphs removes fossil-fuel references, first COP text to acknowledge 1.5C overshoot; Friday deadline looms.

stories.headline: Serbia elects student-backed speaker 140-97
stories.summary: Aleksandar Cupic of the Student List becomes parliament speaker and acting president after Vucic's resignation; rival Stojan Radenovic took 97 votes.

stories.headline: IAEA: North Korea expanding Yongbyon enrichment
stories.summary: IAEA chief Grossi tells the board the Yongbyon uranium enrichment plant has been expanded, calling it a cause for serious concern.

stories.headline: Fiji declares national disaster over El Nino drought
stories.summary: Nationwide disaster declaration as El Nino drought threatens drinking water; emergency support prioritised for remote communities and farmers.

stories.headline: Van Gogh sells for record $190.4 million
stories.summary: Chataigniers en fleurs (1890) sets a Van Gogh auction record at Sotheby's New York after a settlement over its Nazi-era history.

stories.headline: Walmart raises outlook for third time this year
stories.summary: Q3 revenue $188.8bn, up 5.2%; US e-commerce up 23%. Full-year sales growth guide raised to 4.9-5.2% and adjusted EPS to $2.84-2.89.

stories.headline: Indonesia passes asset-forfeiture law
stories.summary: Parliament approves seizing assets linked to corruption and other crimes without a prior conviction, for assets of at least 1 billion rupiah.

stories.headline: Somalia orders UAE ambassador to leave in 72 hours
sources: Somali state news agency via Reuters
stories.summary: Mogadishu expels the UAE envoy and recalls its own, accusing the Emirates of sovereignty violations it calls an open invasion. UAE had not responded.

stories.headline: Russian strike on Odesa kills 4, injures 13
stories.summary: Reported casualty figures as emergency services assessed damage; subject to confirmation.

stories.headline: Trump warns Iran over alleged dirty-bomb plot
sources: New York Times via Just Security
stories.summary: Trump says US would 'wipe them out' if attacked and will 'see what happens' in the Iran war after 1 Jan 2027; Iran denies the plot.

stories.headline: South Korea top court overturns Han Duck-soo conviction
stories.summary: Supreme Court says intent to aid Yoon's 2024 martial-law decree was not sufficiently proven.

stories.headline: Denmark approves Greenland defence deal 109-0
stories.summary: Folketing unanimously backs the September agreement with Greenland and the US to strengthen Arctic and North Atlantic security.

stories.headline: UK to give Ukraine 1,000 long-range strike drones
sources: BBC Politics feed via RSS Orange
stories.summary: PM to announce the pledge at the Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin.

stories.headline: Yunus ancestral home torched amid Bangladesh shutdown
stories.summary: Awami League calls a nationwide shutdown after Hasina's ID request is rejected; Yunus family home reported set ablaze.

stories.headline: Aid groups score Gaza peace plan 4 out of 26
stories.summary: Five aid organisations' joint review scores implementation of the 20-point plan against their April assessment.

stories.headline: 589 million children lived in conflict zones in 2025
stories.summary: Save the Children puts the share at 23.4% of all children, based on proximity to recorded violent events.

stories.headline: Explosion at Cepu refinery kills one worker
stories.summary: Blast at a tank during maintenance shutdown; fire brought under control and cause under investigation, energy ministry says.

stories.headline: Indonesia fire emissions third-highest on record
stories.summary: Copernicus: nearly 200 million tonnes of carbon from fires by 15 Nov, driven by super El Nino dryness and land clearing.

stories.headline: US sanctions three over Southeast Asia scam centres
stories.summary: Treasury sanctions three people and two companies linked to scam compounds in Cambodia and Myanmar targeting Americans and Europeans.

stories.headline: US files emergency bid over Venezuelan TPS
stories.summary: Administration asks the Supreme Court to stay a ruling restoring deportation protections; filing alone does not grant the stay.

stories.headline: Trump asks court to let EPA cancel $16bn in climate grants
sources: Elk Grove Laguna News / AP roundup
stories.summary: Administration seeks Supreme Court intervention over Biden-era clean-energy grants the EPA moved to cancel.

stories.headline: House Democrats nominate Jeffries for Speaker
sources: New York Times via Just Security
stories.summary: Private vote reported 251-11 with two abstentions, ahead of the new Congress in January 2027.

stories.headline: Sanon guilty on all 8 counts in Moise plot
sources: New York Times via Just Security
stories.summary: Florida man Christian Sanon convicted over the conspiracy to kidnap or kill Haiti's President Jovenel Moise in 2021.

stories.headline: US and Venezuela agree to restore military ties
sources: US Defense Secretary via Open Chronicle
stories.summary: Defence Secretary Hegseth announces renewed military communication and intelligence coordination during a Caracas visit.

stories.headline: Tanker hit in Hormuz, crew reported safe
stories.summary: UKMTO 212 relays a time-late engine-room strike report 6 nautical miles north of Khasab; vessels advised to proceed with caution.

stories.headline: LPG tanker Gas Husky sinks off Bulgaria
stories.summary: Liberian-flagged vessel carrying about 3,400 tonnes of LPG from Egypt to Romania sank after being struck by projectiles.

stories.headline: President Lee urges renewed dialogue with Pyongyang
stories.summary: Lee Jae Myung renews his appeal for talks toward durable peace; a Trump-Kim meeting remains unconfirmed.

stories.headline: Takaichi and Putin agree to keep communicating
stories.summary: Japan's PM says she and Putin agreed to maintain contact at various levels, including direct contact.

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan: about 72,000 evacuated in eastern India
stories.summary: Evacuations under way as Cyclone Akvan threatens coastal communities; track and impact still subject to weather updates.

stories.headline: Millions of red crabs begin annual migration
sources: Australian parks reporting via Open Chronicle
stories.summary: Christmas Island's red crabs start their yearly march to the sea, closing roads and drawing global attention.

stories.headline: Rio Tinto commits $250m over Panguna mine legacy
sources: New York Times via Just Security
Rio Tinto agreement via Just Security
stories.summary: Fund addresses long-lasting environmental and human-rights effects of the copper mine closed in 1989, after a six-year complaint.

stories.headline: Kenya picks US consortium for critical minerals project
stories.summary: Residents seek answers as Kenya selects a US consortium for a critical minerals development.

stories.headline: AI cyberattack targeted the EU in October, official says
stories.summary: An official says a cyberattack using artificial intelligence targeted the EU in October; extent and actor not established.

stories.headline: APEC adopts Shenzhen Outlook on trade, data and AI
stories.summary: Leaders adopt a shared economic and digital cooperation agenda; the text defines cooperation as voluntary and non-binding.

stories.headline: US-Philippines pursue loan package over $2 billion
stories.summary: White House says the two countries will pursue financing through Foreign Military Financing; no disbursement announced.

title: The World in One Page
